capabilities.description: Delegate one complete local goal to the selected robot's Robonix Pilot under its admitted deployment profile. RG retains participant matching, Commit/Bind, resource and recovery authority.

Independent onsite arrival and stable-stop attestation for one exact target, physical entity, accepted plan and complete current attempt set. The first admitted source uses explicit human onsite confirmation under a restricted verifier identity; it does not claim automatic localization or autonomous arrival assessment. Source registration creates evidence-publishing authority only, not another robot action, shared-zone clearance or device-stop/recovery authority.

operations.description: General delegation: Pass one complete supported local goal to the already selected robot's Robonix Pilot. Every Task declares a satisfaction basis appropriate to its stated goal. The generic task.delegate contract does not mandate a single patrol verifier for every navigation or movement objective. An execution-report completes the delegated execution lifecycle only; it does not independently prove physical goal achievement, stable stopping, shared-zone clearance or device stop. A physical-goal claim requires its own admitted evidence contract. RG owns physical Actor binding, distinctness, matching, Commit/Bind, resources and recovery authority; do not make Robonix prove RG uniqueness or match local robot names to RG aliases. Robonix owns local execution and immediate safety. Use profile=local-task-v1 only and preserve all authorized local action limits and execution-time conditions in the delegated objective. Fixed named-target patrol profile: The first fixed patrol uses independent execution: dog1 to the tea-room entrance and dog2 to Professor Wang's office entrance. These fixed named-target patrol Tasks must use verifier-evidence with observation.patrol.verify-arrival@v1, an independent onsite source, the exact deployment target-reference predicate binding the target and physical entity, and a 5000 ms receive-age bound. Each robot requires independently verified local map/Scene provenance; do not copy one Node's region coordinates to its peer because map labels match. Pilot done, Nav2 SUCCEEDED, timeout and API acceptance do not prove physical arrival, stable stopping or that a shared door is clear. Missing region/map/source bindings, current chassis evidence, admitted verifier or onsite motion authorization prevent submission of this patrol profile. Other objectives: A bounded 0.5 m body-forward movement contract has not been verified in the deployed local receiver; keep that objective blocked until its actual local support and goal-specific evidence contract are established. Registering the patrol arrival source or changing catalog wording does not make bounded movement executable. Do not invent coordinate, map, stop, relative-step or basic-action operations or motion parameters. Photo/archive/summary tasks require verified native capture and original Artifact receipts first; do not create a fake summary operation or claim an unimplemented photo pipeline is ready. This profile does not authorize fault injection, replacement or motion automatically. Catalog changes do not reinterpret satisfaction or evidence of already accepted Tasks.
